verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's own workflows run timed actions relative to each booked meeting: reminders, multi-action steps, and a Send a webhook action at a set time before or after a meeting. Pending steps follow reschedules and are called off on cancellation, and workflows can auto-attach to new links, so they fire on every booking. However, these are event-relative triggers, not standalone recurring schedules. missing for 10: cron-style or interval-based recurring job scheduling independent of bookings, any recurrence configuration for workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
